steps: Complete Adobe Creative Suite tutorials on LinkedIn Learning (focus on Photoshop and Illustrator first).
Take a beginner Graphic Design course on Coursera (e.g., 'Graphic Design Specialization' by CalArts).
Practice creating motion graphics with Adobe After Effects using free online resources (e.g., Video Copilot).
Build a portfolio of 3-5 projects combining your fine arts background with new design skills.
Network with content creators and photographers on social media to showcase your work and get feedback.
